versions.content: To achieve an even distribution of PDUs to all currently transmitting and/or receiving connections associated with a PDU pool, the PDUs of this pool shall be assigned to active connections using round robin scheduling. A connection that is currently receiving and transmitting may claim two PDUs in one round of the assignment: one for the FC, and one for an SF/FF/CF.
